services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Kingston’s food, fun and entertainment ships are available for private charter. Captivate your guests with history, ambiance, landscape and location aboard an exclusive, chartered cruise in Kingston and the 1000 Islands. Our vessels, the ‘Island Belle,’ ‘Island Star’ and ‘Island Queen,’ make a unique event or wedding venue and an unforgettable experience. Your event coordinator will work together with you to design a combination of charter rate, dining and additional services to match your vision. Rates vary depending on season and sailing time.
